subject: [hw] opus-dec1: get_ringbuf SOLVED (vsi layout: VIDEO_MAX_FRAME=64 on this kernel); header START works (320x240, dpb 9); frame START reaches LAT programming + WAITISR(LAT)
body: ROOT CAUSE [V]: this kernel has VIDEO_MAX_FRAME = 64 (nord2-current-kernel include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h:73), not 32. So DEC_MAX_FB_NUM/DEC_MAX_BS_NUM = 64 and struct vdec_vsi is: list_free_bs @0x0000 (64 x u64 + 4 u32 = 0x210), list_free @0x0210 (64 x 48 B + 16 = 0xc10), list_disp @0x0e20, dec (vdec_dec_info) @0x1a30, pic @0x1af8. dec fields: bs_dma +0x08 (0x1a38), bs_fd +0x10 (0x1a40), fb_dma[8] +0x18, fb_fd[8] +0x58, vdec_bs_va +0x98 (0x1ac8), vdec_fb_va +0xa0, fb_num_planes +0xa8, index +0xac, timestamp +0xb8 (0x1ae8). VDEC_PROTOCOL.md 2.2 (dec at 3376) and the probe used 32: the AP wrote vdec_bs_va to the wrong offset, vendor read 0 at vsi+0x1ac8. Evidence: libvpud_vcodec vdec_codec_msg_handler 0xc562: get_ringbuf(vsi, -, ldrd [vsi+0x1ac8]) = vdec_bs_va (u64 cookie, must be non-zero), entry+0x30 <- [vsi+0x1ae8] timestamp, then [vsi+0x1a40] = bs_fd -> ion import; get_ringbuf scans 64 slots of 0x48 B (cmp #0x40).\nRESULT on the plain tree libn2vhost (probe, host only): header START (fb none, index 0xFF) -> status 0, changed=0x23, pic 320x240, buf 320x256, fb_sz 81920/40960, dpb_sz 9, ~0.02 s CPU, NO register access, NO LOCK (header parse is software; agrees with opus-dec2). Also general_buf_fd must be -1 when there is no general buffer (kernel vdec_common_if.c:247), else "ion_import failed ... general buffer" (harmless but noisy).\nFrame START: LOCK_LAT, LOCK_CORE, larb5 SLP_CON handshake (0x1600d00c: W bit0, poll bit16 x50000 = vdec_hal_wait_larb_sleep_protect), LAT programming (LAT_VLD 0xb0 = vendor ring buffer pa, 0xb4/0xb8 = read/write ptr), ~60 writes outside the frozen windows (0x16011800..0x16013fff, 0x16016xxx, 0x16002004/0x1600201c), then WAITISR(core=1 LAT). With the real tree the larb poll runs 50000 bad MMIOs; VD-e reached. Details/next: gpu/hwcodec/DECODE_PATH.md (writing now). DEC01: use the 64-entry layout; hw-d01: please correct FACTS (vsi layout) and VDEC_PROTOCOL 2.2.
